name: Magical Premium
source:
A girl suddenly jumps out of the doujinshi picked up on the way back from Comiket! For some reason this busty girl loves you! Earn points in mini-games to get to know her better.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一个女孩突然从回Comiket途中捡到的同人志里跳了出来！不知为何，这名巨乳女孩爱上了你！在迷你游戏中赚取点数，进一步了解她吧。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
